exposure: repeat fetoscopic laser surgery for recurrent Twin-to-Twin Transfusion Syndrome (TTTS) or postlaser Twin Anemia Polycythemia Sequence (TAPS)
cohort: Patients with Twin-to-Twin Transfusion Syndrome (TTTS) who either underwent repeat fetoscopic laser surgery for recurrent disease (16 patients) or were successfully treated with a single fetoscopic laser surgery (48 matched controls).
finding: Repeat fetoscopic laser surgery for recurrent TTTS or postlaser TAPS resulted in acceptable outcomes, with no significant difference in median gestational age at delivery, double birth survival, or overall perinatal survival compared to patients successfully treated with a single laser surgery.
gest_age: Gestational age at first laser (epochs <18, 18-23.9, and >=24 weeks) and gestational age at delivery (median 31 vs 32.5 weeks) were primary measures.
